# Harborlight School

> Harborlight School is an independent day school for Kindergarten through Grade 8 on Marblehead harbour in Massachusetts, founded in 1963, with 268 students, an average class of 14 and a 7:1 student-teacher ratio. It also runs Harborlight Summer, a six-session day camp for ages 5 to 13.

## Key facts

- Phone: +1-781-555-0134
- Address: 410 Atlantic Avenue, Marblehead, MA, 01945
- Hours: Mon/Tue/Wed/Thu/Fri 07:45 to 17:30
- Areas served: Marblehead, MA, Swampscott, MA, Salem, MA, Beverly, MA, Lynn, MA, Peabody, MA
- Event: Harborlight School Fall Open House, 2026-10-18T09:30
- Event: Harborlight School Fall Open House, 2026-11-15T09:30
